# AWS Study Prompt Templates

Reusable prompts for creating or reviewing AWS study material while keeping structure, exam relevance, and source verification explicit.

## Available Templates

| Order | Topic | What it covers |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | [Latex Study Document Prompt](latex-study-document-prompt.md) | Study notes and decision points for Latex Study Document Prompt. |
| 2 | [Saa Study Note Prompt](saa-study-note-prompt.md) | Study notes and decision points for Saa Study Note Prompt. |
| 3 | [Service Comparison Prompt](service-comparison-prompt.md) | Study notes and decision points for Service Comparison Prompt. |
| 4 | [Service Explanation Prompt](service-explanation-prompt.md) | Study notes and decision points for Service Explanation Prompt. |

## Usage Notes

- Replace placeholders before using a template.
- Keep CPP and SAA depth separate when a topic requires different treatment.
- Verify volatile AWS facts against current official documentation.
- Do not request or reproduce real exam questions or exam dumps.
